description: This file defines the class RowColumnInformation, which provides static methods related to extracting row and column information from cell references, ranges, and arrays in the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation component.

classes.name: RowColumnInformation
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to determine row and column information from cell references, ranges, and arrays for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: cellAddressNullOrWhitespace
methods.description: Private static method to check if a cell address is null or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: cellColumn
methods.description: Private static method to get the column index of a given Cell object.

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number(s) for a given cell reference or range.

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in an array or reference.

methods.name: cellRow
methods.description: Private static method to get the row index of a given Cell object.

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number(s) for a given cell reference or range.

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in an array or reference.
